component.name: Ultralight Web Cursor
component.summary: Programmable HTML, CSS and JavaScript desktop cursor

description.p: Ultralight Web Cursor renders animated cursor themes made with HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a transparent desktop overlay.
The settings application can select bundled themes, import trusted theme folders, change the render size, and control per-user startup.
The Linux engine requires X11 or XWayland. Windows is supported through the standalone installer.
Unified Linux and Windows standalone engine with a redesigned settings application.
